about: Small CNN for chapter C2, trained offline in PyTorch on MNIST (LeCun et al. 1998) with random shifts up to 2 px, rotations up to 10 degrees and zoom 0.9 to 1.1. Layout: conv 1->6 (3x3), ReLU, max-pool 2, conv 6->12 (3x3), ReLU, max-pool 2, flatten 300, dense 10, softmax. Weights rounded to 4 decimals.
